paper_title: Constraints on axion-like dark matter from a SERF comagnetometer
notes: Paper (NASDUCK-SERF) constrains both ALP-neutron (g_aNN) and ALP-proton (g_aPP) couplings using 3He (neutron) and 39K (proton). The hint suggests AxionNeutron, but the paper's headline novelty is the FIRST reliable terrestrial bounds on ALP-PROTON coupling, so AxionProton is the most distinctive new result. Numerical limits are tabulated only in external repository [57]; exclusion plot (Fig. 2) shows g_aPP roughly 5e-6 to ~1e-3 GeV^-1 over mass range 1.4e-12 to 2e-10 eV. Data points are approximate reads of the mean bound from the figure. Confidence capped at 0.5 because two coupling types are constrained and numeric data is approximate. SHM assumed but no explicit local DM density given.
